name: zclass_cls_di_raycast_find_closest
description: zClass_cls_di::RaycastFindClosest initializes a single-segment DI raycast packet, walks the world grid cells touched by the segment, dispatches eligible nodes, falls back to world children, cleans up the matrix stack, and returns whether no candidate was found.
known_limits: No isolated VC COFF byte comparison is recorded for this large raycast/grid walker; tier S verification is deferred to a coherent zClass cls_di source-cluster pass.
Binary Ninja HLIL expands the x87 min/max, grid-step, and grid-boundary comparisons into status-word temporaries, so functional evidence is tied to the inspected assembly and native smoke.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x444e90 validates null world/class-data error returns, queued type-list update, segment min/max globals, query/end point globals, candidate buffer/cursor setup, matrix-stack identity scope, world-overlap and grid availability gates, floor/_ftol grid-index setup, x/z step and inverse-delta setup, grid cell clamping, virtual-grid offset application and candidate hit-position repair, area child dispatch through BuildPickCandidatesForSegmentChildFallback, break-on-first handling, fallback BuildPickCandidatesForSegment call, MatStackPopPtr cleanup, g_cls_di_StopAfterFirstHit reset, and EAX no-candidate return.

The native cls_di smoke verifies a grid-backed raycast hit through an object child, candidate buffer population, hit position, matrix-stack restoration, stop-after-hit reset, and integration with the single-segment dispatch group.
